title: Magenta Georgette Angrakha Anarkali Suit Set with Zardozi Hand Work & Dupatta
color_custom: Deep magenta with gold zardozi hand work
description:
Rani means queen – a deep magenta angrakha made for every celebration where you want to feel like one.

A rich magenta georgette Anarkali in a graceful angrakha style – the bodice wraps across the front in a deep V, edged with pure zardozi hand work in antique gold. The same zardozi frames the sleeve cuffs, with tiny scattered buttis across the bodice and sleeves. Below the fitted bodice, the skirt opens into a full, floor-sweeping flare finished with rows of shimmering lace at the hem. It comes with comfortable cotton pants and a matching georgette dupatta with a lace border and scattered buttis.

✦ The Details
• Angrakha wrap-style bodice with a deep V-neckline
• Pure zardozi hand work along the angrakha neckline and on the sleeve cuffs
• Small hand-worked buttis across the bodice and sleeves
• Sheer full sleeves
• Full, flowy Anarkali flare, ankle length, with rows of lace at the hem
• Cotton pants
• Georgette dupatta with lace border and buttis
• 3-piece set: Anarkali, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, flowy georgette that falls into rich folds and swirls beautifully. The zardozi is done by hand, so tiny variations are part of its handmade charm. Cotton pants keep you comfortable through long celebrations.

✦ Fit & Size
Fitted through the bodice with a full, flowy flare. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Gold jhumkas with pearls, a small bindi and soft waves for a sangeet, mehndi or wedding; drape the dupatta on one shoulder so the zardozi angrakha stays in view. For Karwa Chauth or Diwali, add bangles and gold juttis. Abroad, a cream or camel long coat looks beautiful over magenta.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Angrakha Anarkali Kurta (georgette, zardozi hand work)
care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth with tissue over the zardozi. Steam or iron on low heat on the reverse side, never directly on the hand work.
